name: crm
description: Lightweight CRM template: accounts, contacts, deals and activities with layouts and a flow that stamps deals.closedAt when a deal is won or lost.

data.name: deals
data.description: Sales opportunities. closedAt is stamped by the 'Stamp deal closed date' flow when the stage becomes WON or LOST.

data.name: activities
data.description: Calls, emails, meetings and tasks logged against a deal or a contact.

data.name: closedAt
data.description: Set automatically when the stage becomes WON or LOST.

data.name: crm-deal-stage
data.description: Sales pipeline stages for deals. WON and LOST are the closed stages.

data.help_text_override: Set automatically when the stage becomes Won or Lost.
